metadata.title: टिपरालैंड की मांग पर पीछे नहीं हटेंगे | No compromise on TIPRA Land | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: TIPRA Motha leaders from Tripura, led by Pradyot Kishore Manikya, held a crucial meeting with Home Ministry officials to discuss the proposed accord. Following the meeting, Manikya spoke exclusively with Main Bhi Bharat editor Chitrita Sanyal. During the interview, he described the meeting as positive but reaffirmed his unwavering stance on their demands, emphasizing that he would not settle for anything less.
